svg.title: Kinds of motion, with exact examples
svg.desc: Four keyboards from B3 to G4. Oblique: C4 + E4 to C4 + F4. Contrary, apart: C4 + E4 to B3 + F4. Contrary, together: B3 + F4 to C4 + E4. Similar: C4 + E4 to D4 + F4. Notes and arrows only; no interval names.

g.text: One voice holds while the other moves.
The voices move in opposite directions: away
